answer: Scarce-seed anomaly ledger. Each agent is issued a unique physical random seed stored in a local vault; its outputs must carry a seed-derived watermark (a relic signature). A public mesa—an append-only ledger of watermark collision events—records any two agents emitting the same relic. Duplication becomes self-revealing because cloning the seed necessarily replicates the watermark, and independent agents cannot collide by chance. New agents must submit a fresh seed attested by hardware entropy; reused seeds surface as collisions.
